page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, utilizing the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It has no local storage or GPU resources, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core capabilities. The instance achieves top-tier performance in stress-ng single-core CPU tests and strong results in Geekbench single-core and text processing benchmarks. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics generally fall into the average range, with large-block memory reads and writes performing moderately. Weaknesses are observed in small-block cached memory reads, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation, and database operations, where the instance scores in the bottom 25%.

Given its dedicated AMD EPYC hardware profile, the ecs.g8ae.xlarge offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose computing. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high single-threaded CPU performance but may present resource-density tradeoffs for memory-intensive or high-throughput database operations due to lower performance in those areas. This instance is best suited for general-purpose applications, text processing, single-threaded batch processing, and moderate web-serving workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or high multi-threaded memory bandwidth.
